incident_text: Portfolio updates are not arriving for about half of users since 11:20. Ops sees the dead-letter queue growing.

E-001.claim: aa-sync deployed a payload-format change one minute before the first consumer errors
E-001.author: reasoning

E-002.claim: portfolio-consumer rejects messages on a field-name mismatch, starting right after the deploy
E-002.excerpt: 2026-04-02T11:20:04Z ERROR portfolio-consumer: schema validation failed: unexpected field 'positions' (expected 'holdings')
E-002.author: reasoning

E-003.claim: aa-sync publishes to portfolio-updates and portfolio-consumer consumes from it
E-003.author: reasoning

E-004.claim: The dead-letter queue grew to 2500 on the portfolio-updates queue
E-004.author: reasoning

E-005.claim: Redeliveries rose sharply, consistent with repeated rejection
E-005.author: reasoning

E-006.claim: Publish rate stayed steady while consume rate fell, so this is not a producer outage
E-006.author: reasoning

E-007.claim: portfolio-consumer error rate rose to 0.604 while latency stayed flat, which points to validation rejects rather than slowness
E-007.author: reasoning

E-008.claim: portfolio-consumer also had a deploy at 10:50, described as a log level tweak, well before onset
E-008.author: reasoning

H1.statement: aa-sync-00633 changed the published holdings payload (field 'holdings' renamed to 'positions'). portfolio-consumer's strict schema rejects these messages, which are then redelivered and dead-lettered.

H2.statement: portfolio-consumer-00091 (10:50, 'log level tweak') contributed to the failure. This is unlikely given the 30-minute gap before onset and the nature of the change.

notes: Why only about half of users are affected: a partial aa-sync rollout, a mix of payload types, or only some message types changed. This was not verified.
The log sample covers only 30 of 180 matching errors, so I did not check whether other error types exist later in the window.
Whether messages with the old 'holdings' field are still being processed successfully was not verified.
portfolio-consumer-00091 is very likely unrelated, but its diff was not inspected.
